{{dablink|For other uses of the word "wind," see [[Wind]].}}
'''Dandelion in the Wind''' is a [[sword form]]. The movements for this form are unknown. [[Lan Mandragoran]] once used this form to slice open an assassin's throat after using [[The Rose Unfolds]].{{ref/book|0|16}} The form's name may allude to the spray of blood from a throat wound looking similarly to a dandelion spraying in the wind.
